Description:
As you evade an oncoming arrow, your focus shifts, leaving you vulnerable to the sudden onslaught of a raptor lunging at your throat. A whirlwind of steel and fang ensues, and as a sword is close to striking you, the attack suddenly stops. "You're no monster" he says as he unsheathes his sword, searching for tracks in the mud. "Best mind your own business, friend. The one I'm seeking is nearby... and it is seeking you."
Hunters are keen predators, who fight alongside one (or multiple) trusted beastly companions. While able to cast some rudimentary magic, spellcasting is not their focus, and they more than make up in terms of raw ferocity and power to kill.
A hunter can always navigate their surroundings, and can track down any monster, or person alike, no matter the scope.
Quick Note: Hunters are keen predators, who fight alongside one (or multiple) trusted beastly companions. While able to cast some rudimentary magic, spellcasting is not their focus, and they more than make up in terms of raw ferocity and power to kill.
Weapons: You are Trained in 2 Weapon Categories of choice (e.g. One-Handed Melee, Two-Handed Ranged, Shields, etc).

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Hunter-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

~Animal Companion~.Effect:
You have an animal pet that can fight alongside you!
Your pet has the Stats 3, 1, 0, 0, -1 in any order, but they do not affect its Combat capabilities.
It has Max Health equal to ^8 + 200% of Your Level^.
Your pet acts on your Turn. It has 2 {A}Action Points, but it can only attack once per Turn.
~Animal Companion~.Upgrade:
If your pet drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It's Health Regen is equal to half of its Max Health.
Your pet will not stray more than 30 meters away from you in hostile territory.
~Animal Companion~.Notes:
Your pet can't do Default Moves except Taunt.
Your pet can make normal non-Combat Rolls using using its own Stats.
If your pet ever dies, you can spend 8 hours inbetween Adventures to get a new pet. If you want to change your pet and abandon your current one, you can do so inbetween Adventures, but the guilt will make you Fumbling for the next 2 Worthy Combat encounters.

~Pet Attack~.Effect: Your pet attacks a target for 1d4 Pierce or Slash Damage (your choice).

~Animal Companion~.Name: ~Animal Companion~

~Dodge Roll~.Effect:
Use when taking Damage (or any time on your Turn).
Roll 2 meters in any possible direction. Reduce the Damage by 50%.
~Dodge Roll~.Upgrade: ^You^ can use this to make your pet Dodge Roll instead.
~Dodge Roll~.Name: ~Dodge Roll~

~Bear Necessities~.Effect: Choose 2 Pet Talents and 2 Utility Talents from below to give to your pet.
~Bear Necessities~.Upgrade: They all apply to your pet instead of yourself.
~Bear Necessities~.Name: ~Bear Necessities~

~Bite~.Effect: Each of your pets makes a Pet Attack for free.
~Bite~.Name: ~Bite~

~Mind Bond~.Effect: At any point, you can tap into your pet's mind and see through its eyes, hear through its ears and smell through its nose.
~Mind Bond~.Upgrade: As a Lone Wolf, you can use this to tap into any animal's mind you can see.
~Mind Bond~.Name: ~Mind Bond~

~Large~.Effect: Your pet is Large and occupies a 2x2 meter area.
~Large~.Name: ~Large~

Combat Extras: You can ride your pet for +50% Speed
~Ridable Steed~.Effect: Your pet is ridable as a mount and has +50% Movement Speed outside combat.
~Ridable Steed~.Name: ~Ridable Steed~

~Opposable Thumbs~.Effect: Your pet has opposable thumbs and can use Potions, Scrolls and other similar items.
~Opposable Thumbs~.Name: ~Opposable Thumbs~

~Flying~.Effect: Your pet can fly at its normal Movement Speed.
~Flying~.Name: ~Flying~

~Dig~.Effect: Your pet can dig and move through dirt as if it were just Hard Terrain.
~Dig~.Name: ~Dig~
~Dig~.Notes: Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.

Combat Extras: Your pet can walk on walls
~Wallwalking~.Effect: Your pet can walk on walls and ceilings at normal speed.
~Wallwalking~.Downside: As a Lone Wolf, requires Level 4.
~Wallwalking~.Upgrade: At Level 4, ^you^ can also crawl on walls and ceilings at half of your speed by trailing behind your pet.
~Wallwalking~.Name: ~Wallwalking~

Combat Extras: Your pet can swim and hold its breath
~Amphibious~.Effect: Your pet can swim at normal speed and hold its breath for up to 1 hour.
~Amphibious~.Upgrade: At Level 4, ^you^ can also swim at normal speed and hold your breath for twice as long by trailing behind your pet.
~Amphibious~.Name: ~Amphibious~

~Purr~.Effect:
Your pet removes all combat-affecting Debuffs and Control Effects on a Unit.
Also cure any non-chronic and non-terminal illness or disease on the Unit.
~Purr~.Name: ~Purr~

~Mimick Sound~.Effect: Your pet tries to briefly mimick a sound. It makes a Presence or Focus Roll to determine its accuracy.
~Mimick Sound~.Notes: The sound can have no combat effects. It may try to immitate voice but the more complex the speech, the harder the Roll will be.
~Mimick Sound~.Name: ~Mimick Sound~

Extras: Your pet can carry items on its back
~Pack Mule~.Effect: Your pet can carry items equal to 200% of its Might.
~Pack Mule~.Name: ~Pack Mule~

~Tremor Sense~.Effect: Your pet detects the locations of all Units within 15 meters.
~Tremor Sense~.Upgrade: Also, passively, it is immune to being Blind.
~Tremor Sense~.Notes:
Does not detect Units that don't touch the ground.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
~Tremor Sense~.Name: ~Tremor Sense~

~Messenger~.Effect: Your pet leaves for a destination you've been to before at double the regular travel speed, then returns, finding its way to you wherever you are.
~Messenger~.Upgrade: It will most likely return unharmed.
~Messenger~.Name: ~Messenger~

~Living Hive~.Effect:
Instead of being one creature, your pet is a _swarm_ of small creatures that act as one Unit.
Once per Turn, it can rejoin or split into 2 different Units with half of its Health each.
They together still have 2 {A}Action Points per Turn, in total.
~Living Hive~.Name: ~Living Hive~

Other Abilities Description: Choose up to 2 Pet Talents to give to your pet. These are permanent and can only be changed by retraining your pet in later levels, via special Talents.

~Grasping Talons~.Effect:
If an enemy starts its Turn next to your pet, it is Taunted by it.
If it moves outside of your pet's melee range, it Pet Attacks it for free using a Reaction.
~Grasping Talons~.Name: ~Grasping Talons~

~Spiky~.Effect: After a Unit makes an Attack on your pet from 1 meter away, the attacker takes 1d4 Pierce Damage.
~Spiky~.Name: ~Spiky~

~Stand Proud~.Effect: Other allies within 1 meter of your pet have Cover from Ranged attacks.
~Stand Proud~.Name: ~Stand Proud~

~Breath Attack~.Effect:
Choose an element.
Your pet's attack range becomes 5 meters and deals Damage of the chosen element Type.
Another chosen Unit near the target takes 50% of the dealt Damage.
~Breath Attack~.Name: ~Breath Attack~

~Quillshot~.Effect: All Units within 3 meters are shot with arrow-like quills and take 1d6 + 1d8 Pierce Damage.
~Quillshot~.Name: ~Quillshot~

~Venomous Attacks~.Effect: Your pet's attacks deal +1d4 extra Poison Damage to targets already affected by a Control Effect.
~Venomous Attacks~.Name: ~Venomous Attacks~

~Ambushing~.Effect: Your pet's Pet Attack attack every Combat deals +1d6 Damage.
~Ambushing~.Name: ~Ambushing~

~Antler Charge~.Effect:
Your pet has +1 Movement Speed.
If your pet moved at least 4 meters in a straight line this Turn, then attacked a target in front of it, Slam the target +1d4 Damage away from your pet.
~Antler Charge~.Name: ~Antler Charge~

~Leaping~.Effect: Your pet leaps next to a Unit, Blinding it.
~Leaping~.Name: ~Leaping~
~Leaping~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Sticky Trap~.Effect: Your pet deploys a trap made of web, goo or a similar substance. When a Unit steps on it, it becomes Rooted.
~Sticky Trap~.Notes:
Can be deployed directly underneath a Unit to trigger instantly!
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.
~Sticky Trap~.Name: ~Sticky Trap~

~Grab and Throw~.Effect: Your pet picks up and Slams a Medium or smaller Unit up to 1d8 in any direction.
~Grab and Throw~.Name: ~Grab and Throw~

~Lick Wounds~.Effect: Your pet heals a Unit near it for 1d8.
~Lick Wounds~.Name: ~Lick Wounds~

Starting Abilities Description.Animal Companion: As a Hunter, you always have your trusted Animal Companion with you. It is both your protectee and protector. Make sure you give it a fitting name and personality, and decide what kind of animal it is. Is it a large mammal, a majestic bird, a sly lizard, or even a giant insect? The choice is yours.

Starting Abilities Description.Dodge Roll: Dodge Roll allows you to dodge-roll to avoid some of the Damage, or can be used on your Turn to immediately move 2 meters without using an Action Point.

Starting Abilities Description.Pet Talents: Your pet has a baseline of 2 Pet Talents. These are special Pet Abilities that give your animal companion extra power. You can pick between having it be more tanky, focus on Damage or area attacks, or even give it a Healing Ability.

Specializations.Description: At Level 1, you can choose your specialization.
Choices: Draven, a tracker and hunter of beats and men, never lost and never without purpose
Beastmaster, a pack hunter, who finds friends in even the most ruthless of beasts

~Hunter Mark~.Effect:
Choose and ^Mark^ a target you can see.
Your own single target attacks and Abilities against the ^Marked^ target have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Hunter Mark~.Notes:
Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
Your pets' attacks don't increase.
A Unit can only have one Hunter Mark on it at a time.
~Hunter Mark~.Name: ~Hunter Mark~

<Lone Wolf>.Effect:
You renounce your Animal Companion, but gain Health and Health Regen equal to its Health.
All your pet's Talents and Abilities apply to you instead, and your first attack each Turn deals extra Damage equal to your pet's attack.
Choose one more Pet Talent for yourself.
<Lone Wolf>.Notes: You no longer have access to the Animal Companion.
<Lone Wolf>.Name: <Lone Wolf>

Combat Extras: Your pet can start anywhere within 5 meters of you
~Team of Two~.Effect:
Your pet gains +5 Skill Points it can use for its own non-Combat Skills (that make sense for an animal to have).
It may start Combat from anywhere within 5 meters of you, within line of sight.
~Team of Two~.Name: ~Team of Two~

<Fetch!>.Effect: Refresh the Cooldown of one of your pet's Abilities.
<Fetch!>.Upgrade: For Lone Wolves, this costs 1 {A}Action Point.
<Fetch!>.Name: <Fetch!>

<Hunting Trap>.Effect:
Deploy a Hunting Trap near you armed in a certain way that it's stronger than usual.
When a Unit steps on it, it takes 1d10 Damage, gets a Combo and ends its Movement.
<Hunting Trap>.Upgrade: Requires a Hunting Trap, which can be bought or crafted for 100 {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold.
<Hunting Trap>.Notes: Also ends dashes, pushes, and Slams (Slams don't do collision Damage).
<Hunting Trap>.Name: <Hunting Trap>

~Refire Dodge Roll~.Effect:
Use when taking Damage (or any time on your Turn).
Roll 2 meters in any possible direction. Reduce the Damage by 50%. ~Then move the Hunter Mark (if any) to the Damage source Unit (if any).~
~Refire Dodge Roll~.Upgrade: ^You^ can use this to make your pet Dodge Roll instead.
~Refire Dodge Roll~.Notes: ~The Cooldown is now also Twice / Combat.~
~Refire Dodge Roll~.Name: ~Refire Dodge Roll~

<Bounty Hunting>.Effect:
When ^you^ kill your ^Marked^ target, gain 1d100 {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold and Heal an ally within 6 meters for 1d6.
If it's the 1st or 2nd Round, move the ^Mark^ to another Unit.
<Bounty Hunting>.Name: <Bounty Hunting>

<Poison Trap>.Effect:
Deploy a special poison trap near you.
When a Unit steps on it, the 5x5 meter area around it becomes filled with _noxious cloud_.
Whenever a Unit makes an Act while inside the _noxious cloud_, it takes 1d4 Poison Damage.
<Poison Trap>.Upgrade: Requires a Hunting Trap, which can be bought or crafted for 100 {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold.
<Poison Trap>.Notes: Can be deployed directly underneath a Unit to trigger instantly!
<Poison Trap>.Name: <Poison Trap>

~Tracker~.Effect:
You have +2 in Tracking (non-Combat Skill)
You always know where North is in non-magical environments.
You and your pets are unaffected by Hard Terrain.
~Tracker~.Name: ~Tracker~
~Tracker~.Notes: Moving 1 meter through Hard Terrain takes 2 meters of Movement.

~Infused Shots~.Effect: You can change your weapon attacks' Damage Type to {Type}.
~Infused Shots~.Name: ~Infused Shots~

<Pet Versatile Training>.Effect: When you get this Talent and at the end of every Adventure, you can change one of your pet's Pet Talents.
<Pet Versatile Training>.Name: <Pet Versatile Training>

~Harpoon~.Effect: Your first {Type} weapon attack each Combat {Pulls} the target {Where}.
~Harpoon~.Notes: The target stops if it collides with something.
~Harpoon~.Name: ~Harpoon~

<Slayer>.Effect:
You always know the type of a monster. You gain a different boon when ^you^ defeat a Worthy Enemy of a certain type:

{DarkGreen('Beasts:')} Heal an Ally for 1d4.
{DarkGreen('Demons:')} Your pet gains +1 Damage this Combat.
{DarkGreen('Fiends:')} Gain 50 {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold.
{DarkGreen('People:')} Your next attack Cripples the target.
{DarkGreen('Undead:')} Your pet's next attack Single-Stuns the target.
<Slayer>.Name: <Slayer>
<Slayer>.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -100% Damage/Healing.

<Bandage Wounds>.Effect: Heal a Unit for 1d6 for each 10 Health it is missing.
<Bandage Wounds>.Name: <Bandage Wounds>

<Pet Versatile Trainings>.Effect: When you get this Talent and at the end of every Adventure, you can change one Pet Talent of one of your pets.
<Pet Versatile Trainings>.Name: <Pet Versatile Trainings>

<Pet Training 101>.Effect:
Choose one more Pet Talent.
While you have this Talent, your pet also has that Pet Talent.
<Pet Training 101>.Name: <Pet Training 101>

<Spell Trap>.Effect:
Choose any `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` Spell.
Spend 1 {A}Action Point plus the Spell's {A}Action Point cost, an Ally may spend the {Mana}Mana Cost, and respecting its Cooldown, cast it on a _trap_, which you can deploy on the ground near you.
The trap triggers on the Unit that steps on it.
<Spell Trap>.Upgrade:
The total cost can't exceed 3 {A}Action Points, and not usable with Reaction Spells.          
Requires a Hunting Trap, which can be bought or crafted for 100 {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold.
<Spell Trap>.Notes: Single-target Spells may benefit from ^Marked^. Area effects are cast wherever you want as long as the target is within the area. The trap is treated as the origin of the Spell.
<Spell Trap>.Name: <Spell Trap>

<Treesposition>.Effect: Touch a piece of of a Large or larger piece of wood. Teleport near a similar piece of wood within 6 meters.
<Treesposition>.Name: <Treesposition>

~Mine Field~.Effect: You and your pet's traps have a deploy range of 15 meters range (require Line of Sight).
~Mine Field~.Name: ~Mine Field~

<Crosshair Shot>.Effect:
Dash up to 2 meters, then shoot a special shot at a Unit that ignores and destroys environmental Cover if it's breakable.
It deals 8d8 Damage at exactly 8 meters range:
List: For each meter to the target, it deals 1d8 Pierce Damage, up to 8 meters.
For each meter to the target over 8 meters, it deals -1d8 Damage.
<Crosshair Shot>.Notes: At exactly 8 meters range, the attack deals 8d6 Damage. At 7 and 9 meters, it deals 7d6. At 6 and 10 meters, 6d6. And so on.
<Crosshair Shot>.Name: <Crosshair Shot>

~Tag-Team Mark~.Effect:
Choose and mark a target you can see. ~Your pet immediately dashes to the target and performs a Pet Attack if it's within 6 meters of the target.~
Your own ~and your pet's~ single target attacks and Abilities against the marked target have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Tag-Team Mark~.Notes:
Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
A Unit can only have one Hunter Mark on it at a time.
Your pet lands on the closest space near the target.
~Tag-Team Mark~.Name: ~Tag-Team Mark~

~Chaser Mark~.Effect:
Choose and mark a target you can see. ~If it's a non-Epic Unit, it is perpetually Single-Stunned while Marked.~
Your own single target attacks and Abilities against the marked target have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Chaser Mark~.Notes:
Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
A Feared Unit can only do one Act on its turn (e.g. move, make one attack, use one Ability, etc).
A Unit can only have one Hunter Mark on it at a time.
Your pet lands on the closest space near the target.

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
~Chaser Mark~.Name: ~Chaser Mark~

<Pet Training 102>.Effect:
Choose one more Pet Talent.
While you have this Talent, your pet also has that Pet Talent.
<Pet Training 102>.Name: <Pet Training 102>

<Fang and Claw>.Requirement: You can only have Fang and Claw once
<Fang and Claw>.Effect: Pet Attack deals 1d6 Damage instead of 1d4.
<Fang and Claw>.Notes: This Talent is also available at an earlier Level, and does ^not^ stack with this.
<Fang and Claw>.Name: <Fang and Claw>

<Tremor Wave>.Effect:
Shoot a thundering shot towards an obstacle or wall. A quaking wave travels horizontally towards in both directions of the wall up to 10 meters in each direction.
All Units within 2 meters of that wall must succeed a Might Check at least equal to your Presence Check or be Triple-Stunned and take 3d4 Shock Damage.
They take half of the Damage and are Single-Stun even if they pass.
<Tremor Wave>.Notes:
The floor and ceiling are not considered walls. The wave does not travel through them. This is considered a Spell. Ignores Cover.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Double-Stunned Unit has -3 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
<Tremor Wave>.Name: <Tremor Wave>

<Improved Hunter Mark>.Effect: Hunter Mark makes your ^Dice^ further ^Upgraded^ to the next die type.
<Improved Hunter Mark>.Name: <Improved Hunter Mark>

<Leafwalk>.Effect: You and your pet become ^invisible^. While a Unit is _leafwalking_, it heals for 1d4 whenever it does an Act. Lasts until the end of your next turn (or for 12 seconds if not in combat).
<Leafwalk>.Name: <Leafwalk>

<Fang and Claw>.Effect: Pet Attack deals 1d6 Damage instead of 1d4.
<Fang and Claw>.Name: <Fang and Claw>

<Stepmark>.Effect: When a Unit steps on one of your traps on its Turn, it becomes ^Marked^ until the end of your next Turn.
<Stepmark>.Name: <Stepmark>

<Friendly Mark>.Effect:
When you ^Mark^ an ally, they have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type until the end of their Turn.
Then, reapply the Mark to an Enemy.
<Friendly Mark>.Name: <Friendly Mark>

<Chase!>.Effect: Your pet's attacks and Abilities have their ^Dice^ further ^Upgraded^ to the next die type against ^Marked^ Units.
<Chase!>.Downside: Lone Wolves can not gain this Talent.
<Chase!>.Name: <Chase!>

<Eagle Eye Bloodbath>.Effect:
ALL Worthy Units become ^Marked^ until the start of your next Turn.
ALL Units can benefit from attacking ^Marked^ Units.
<Eagle Eye Bloodbath>.Name: <Eagle Eye Bloodbath>

<That One In Particular>.Effect: When Combat starts, a _random_ Enemy becomes automatically ^Marked^.
<That One In Particular>.Notes: The Quest Master chooses the 'random' target.
<That One In Particular>.Name: <That One In Particular>

<Pierce and Cleave>.Effect: When making a single-target attack on a Unit, your attack hits another Unit, depending on the weapon range:
List: If ranged, the attack hits the first Unit behind the main target within 3 meters of it, on a line, for 50% of the base Damage of the attack.
If melee, the attack hits one Unit of choice within 2 meters of the target, for 50% of the base Damage of the attack.
<Pierce and Cleave>.Upgrade: For Ranged attacks, the Unit behind the main target can be at most at a 45 degree angle.
<Pierce and Cleave>.Notes: For ranged, you choose the target if multiple Units are tied in distance. It
<Pierce and Cleave>.Name: <Pierce and Cleave>

<Marked for Criticals>.Effect: After you apply ^Marked^ to a Unit, it takes maximum Damage from the next dice roll.
<Marked for Criticals>.Notes: For example, after you Hunter Mark a Unit, if you attack it for 2d8 Damage, you don't roll; it just takes 16 Damage. Applies to bonuses like Dice Upgrades, Smites, etc.
<Marked for Criticals>.Name: <Marked for Criticals>

~Cupcake Shot~.Effect: After a Unit steps on one of your traps, it becomes Frail.
~Cupcake Shot~.Name: ~Cupcake Shot~
~Cupcake Shot~.Notes: A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.

<Eye of the Hawk>.Effect:
All enemies in a Worthy Combat are automatically _Marked_, and your range increases by 500% and your ^Dice^ are further ^Upgraded^ to the ^next^ die type against _Marked_ Units. After manually casting Hunter Mark, your first attack deals 50% more Damage against that Unit.
You automatically pass all Hard Instinct Checks (that require at least 15) and your Presence and Instinct increase by an extra 2.
<Eye of the Hawk>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Eye of the Hawk>.Name: <Eye of the Hawk>

<Eye of the Raptor>.Effect:
Your attacks deal maximum Damage to Units that are not _Marked_ if they are within 3 meters of you or your pet.
You automatically pass all Hard Presence Checks (that require at least 15) and you gain +3 Presence.
<Eye of the Raptor>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Eye of the Raptor>.Name: <Eye of the Raptor>

~Prowl Around~.Effect: You have +2 in Hearing, Seeing, and Smelling.
~Prowl Around~.Notes: This is because of your Animal Companions roaming about.
~Prowl Around~.Name: ~Prowl Around~

~Stablemaster~.Effect:
You have 3 different Animal Companion pets, but only one can adventure with you at a time.
Each of your Animal Companions has 2 Utility Talents and 2 Level 1 Pet Talents.

While not with you, your other Animal Companions hang out on their own in the wilderness, but no more than 5 kilometers away from you.
You can send your current companion off, then spend 30 minutes to call for another one to come join you.
~Stablemaster~.Notes:
The advantage is you can use several animal Abilities that have longer Cooldowns; these are usually stronger.
It is possible that the animal you're calling can't come to your aid if you're indoors, flying or the trail you're on is too difficult. In that case, you will have to return outside or on a safe trail (QM's decision).
In that case, your current companion can not go away, either.
~Stablemaster~.Name: ~Stablemaster~

~Talented Animals~.Effect: Your Level 4, 7, and 9 Talent Tiers apply to your pets. Each of your pets can have one of those Talents at those Levels.
~Talented Animals~.Name: ~Talented Animals~

~Bite and Slash~.Effect: Refresh the Cooldown of one of your pet's Pet Attack.
~Bite and Slash~.Name: ~Bite and Slash~

~Tear!~.Effect: One of your pets gains 2 {A}Action Points this Turn.
~Tear!~.Name: ~Tear!~

<Pet Versatile Trainings>.Effect: When you get this Talent and at the end of every Adventure, you can change one Pet Talent of one of your pets.
<Pet Versatile Trainings>.Name: <Pet Versatile Trainings>

~Infused Bites~.Effect: You can change your pet's attacks' Damage Type to {Type}.
~Infused Bites~.Name: ~Infused Bites~

~Apex Companion~.Effect:
You have an animal pet that can fight alongside you!
Your pet has the Stats ~5, 2, 0, 0, -1~ in any order, but they do not affect its Combat capabilities.
It has Max Health equal to ~16 + 400% of Your Level~.
Your pet acts on your Turn. It has ~3 {A}Action Points~, but it can only attack once per Turn.
~It has 4 Level 1 Pet Talents and gains +2 Pet Talents whenever it would gain one.~
~Apex Companion~.Upgrade:
If your pet drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It's Health Regen is equal to half of its Max Health.
Your pet will not stray more than 30 meters away from you in hostile territory.
~Apex Companion~.Notes:
Your pet can't do Default Moves except Taunt.
Your pet can make normal non-Combat Rolls using using its own Stats.
Your pet can't rise from being Fallen while in Combat, even if healed.
If your pet ever dies, you can spend 8 hours inbetween Adventures to get a new pet. If you want to change your pet and abandon your current one, you can do so inbetween Adventures, but the guilt will make you Fumbling for the next 2 Worthy Combat encounters.

~Pet Attack~.Effect:
Your pet attacks a target for 1d4 Pierce or Slash Damage (your choice).

~The Cooldown is now Twice / Turn.~

~Apex Companion~.Name: ~Apex Companion~

<Kindred Spirits>.Effect:
One more of your Animal Companions accompanies you while adventuring.
This Animal Companion obeys the same rules as the regular one (takes its Turns, requires Healing between combats, etc).
<Kindred Spirits>.Notes: You're instantly kicked from the group if your pets don't have names.
<Kindred Spirits>.Name: <Kindred Spirits>

~Go!~.Effect:
Your current pet exits Combat. Summon one of your other pets who joins Combat on any space within 5 meters of you.
Each of your pets has +1 Level 1 Pet Talent.
~Go!~.Name: ~Go!~

~Rescue Mission~.Effect: Pick up an ally within 3 meters, then move with them up to your speed and drop them near your landing space.
~Rescue Mission~.Name: ~Rescue Mission~

<Double Training>.Effect: Your pet gains one more Level 1 Pet Talent.
<Double Training>.Name: <Double Training>

~Killing Machine~.Effect: When your pet kills a Worthy Enemy, it gins +1 Max Health permanently.
~Killing Machine~.Name: ~Killing Machine~

~Scavenge~.Effect: Your pet goes scavenging and comes back 1 real hour later with 1d20 {{Gold}Gold}{Gold}Gold.
~Scavenge~.Name: ~Scavenge~

~Quickfooted~.Effect: Your pet has +1 Initiative and no Pet Attack Cooldown on its first Turn each Combat.
~Quickfooted~.Name: ~Quickfooted~

~Lacerate~.Effect: Attack a Unit for 1d8 Damage and apply a ~Combo~.
~Lacerate~.Name: ~Lacerate~

<Ravage!>.Effect:
One pet makes a melee Attack for 5d6 Slash Damage.
If the target is at or below 50% Health, deal 2d6 extra Damage.
Otherwise, it becomes Frail.
<Ravage!>.Name: <Ravage!>
<Ravage!>.Notes: A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.

<Sickem>.Effect:
Use when a Unit goes flying against its will on someone else's turn.
Your pet(s) within 5 meters of its landing place can dash to it (after it lands) and make a total of 2 Pet Attacks on it.
<Sickem>.Notes:
Goes flying means is pushed, knocked up, dragged, etc.
This uses YOUR Reaction, not your pets'.
Obviously, your pets need line of sight and can't jump through walls, or over large obstacles. Apply common sense.
<Sickem>.Name: <Sickem>

<Second Winds>.Effect: Instantly Heal yourself and all your pets for 3d6.
<Second Winds>.Name: <Second Winds>

~Search~.Effect:
Name or describe a Unit that is familiar to you. Your animals go and search for your target.
They point which direction (straight) the target is.
~Search~.Name: ~Search~

~Camouflage~.Effect:
You and all your pets (if any) become camouflaged and turn effectively invisible and causing no sound, undetectable by the naked eye.
While camouflaged, your Movement is halved.
You appear, however, in mirrors, reflections and in recordings (as well as your sounds).
~Camouflage~.Name: ~Camouflage~

~Sentience~.Effect: One of your pets becomes sentient as if it were a person with 0 or more Intelligence. It can speak, reason, and think like a person.
~Sentience~.Downside: Once given, the gift of sentience can't be unlearned or taken away.
~Sentience~.Name: ~Sentience~

<Fang and Claw>.Effect: Pet Attack deals 1d6 Damage instead of 1d4.
<Fang and Claw>.Name: <Fang and Claw>

<Vampiric>.Effect: Pet Attack heals your pet for 100% of its Damage dealt.
<Vampiric>.Name: <Vampiric>

~Final Blow~.Effect:
Dash onto a target and deal 3d4 Pierce or Smash Damage.
Then become Stunned until the end of the Combat.
~Final Blow~.Name: ~Final Blow~

~Ferocious~.Effect: Your pet's Abilities (except Pet Attack) have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Ferocious~.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.
~Ferocious~.Name: ~Ferocious~

~Swallow~.Effect:
Swallow a non-Epic Unit at most as large as the pet.
While swallowed, it is Blinded.
At the start of your next Turn, spit it out near you.
~Swallow~.Name: ~Swallow~
~Swallow~.Notes: A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

~Pack Tactics~.Effect: When the Hunter or another pet attacks a Unit, make a Pet Attack on it if in Range.
~Pack Tactics~.Name: ~Pack Tactics~

~Teamwork 101~.Effect: Each Turn, alternating your attacks with your pet's attacks in sequence on the same target makes the attacks have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type
~Teamwork 101~.Notes:
"Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1."
A first attack each Turn can not benefit from the Dice Upgrade.
For example, if you start your Turn with Pet Attack with your wolf, and then you hit the target with a sword, the sword attack will have Dice Upgraded. Then if your Spider attacks the same target, it also has Dice Upgraded.
~Teamwork 101~.Name: ~Teamwork 101~

~Shared Love~.Effect: When one of your pet receives Healing above its Max Health, the extra Healing is transferred to another ally in your party.
~Shared Love~.Name: ~Shared Love~

~Consume and Adapt~.Effect:
One of your pets consumes the corpse of a non-humanoid Unit.
It permanently learns one of its Abilities (except its standard attack) and can use it with at least* a Once / Encounter Cooldown.
~Consume and Adapt~.Notes: The Cooldown is overridden if longer than Once / Encounter (e.g. Once / Adventure).
~Consume and Adapt~.Name: ~Consume and Adapt~

<Coordinated Bite>.Effect: One enemy near each of your pets (and/or summons) becomes Single-Stunned, Blinded and Deafened.
<Coordinated Bite>.Name: <Coordinated Bite>
<Coordinated Bite>.Notes:
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.

<Call To Action>.Effect: Call to one more of your animal companions! It appears from the wilderness and fights for up to 1 minute as if it were a normal Animal Companion.
<Call To Action>.Name: <Call To Action>

~ENORMOUS~.Effect: Your pet is Huge (3x3) and its Maximum Health increases by 100%.
~ENORMOUS~.Name: ~ENORMOUS~

~Brood~.Effect: Spawn a temporary Small copy of your pet, with all of its Abilities. It has 50% of its Health, -1 {A}Action Points, and deals -50% Damage.
~Brood~.Name: ~Brood~

~Symbiosis~.Effect: Your pet is a symbiote that can attach itself to one of its allies. While attached, the pet can withgo all of its {A}Action Points to give the ally +1 {A}Action Point this Turn and a 1d6 Shielding.
~Symbiosis~.Name: ~Symbiosis~

~Hovering Entity~.Effect: If not in Combat, your pet is hovers or prowls the battlefield untargetable, and it can take Turns with unlimited Range on its attacks and Abilities.
~Hovering Entity~.Name: ~Hovering Entity~

<Shapeshifting Pet>.Effect:
Transform one of your pets into another form of your liking, possibly replacing any Talents it has with any other.
Passively, your Pets gain +3 in all Stats, +10 Health, +2 Movement Speed and +1d4 Damage on all attacks.
<Shapeshifting Pet>.Upgrade: If you have the Wild Single Talent, you can turn a pet into a combination of 2 Animals.
<Shapeshifting Pet>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Shapeshifting Pet>.Name: <Shapeshifting Pet>

<Cryptid Tamer>.Effect:
One of your Animal Companions becomes a Beast, Dragon or Insect from the `Monsters page$/Other/Monsters` worth less than 1000 XP. It doesn't have a regular Pet Attack, but it has exactly the Abilities and attacks, but only 50% of its Max Health. It obeys the rest of your Animal Companion rules as normal.
Passively, your Pets automatically pass all Very Hard Presence Checks (requiring at least 20).
<Cryptid Tamer>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
<Cryptid Tamer>.Name: <Cryptid Tamer>
